porsche-911.author: Alexander Migl
porsche-911.alt: Porsche 911 Carrera coupé (992.2) in pale grey-green with black wheels, front three-quarter view
porsche-911.note: 992.2 generation (2024 on, current in India): front bumper with vertical active-cooling flaps and no separate light strip above the intakes. Photographed at Porsche Zentrum Stuttgart; identical to Indian CBU cars.

porsche-911.author: Alexander Migl
porsche-911.alt: Porsche 911 Carrera coupé (992.2) in pale grey-green, rear three-quarter view
porsche-911.note: Same 992.2 coupé (plate ES-CL 992) from the rear, with the full-width light bar and louvred engine lid.

porsche-taycan.file: File:Porsche Taycan 9J1 II Carrara White Metallic 01.jpg
porsche-taycan.author: Ethan Llamas
porsche-taycan.alt: Porsche Taycan (2024 facelift) in Carrara White, front three-quarter view
porsche-taycan.note: Facelifted Taycan (9J1 II, 2024 on): flatter four-point headlamps and redesigned bumper without the earlier vertical air-curtain slots. Philippine-registered; Indian CBU cars are the same.

porsche-taycan.author: Alexander-93
porsche-taycan.alt: Porsche Taycan (2024 facelift) in white, rear three-quarter view
porsche-taycan.note: Facelift rear light bar in glass look with integrated PORSCHE lettering (checked on a crop). Porsche Zentrum Stuttgart dealer plate.

porsche-panamera.author: Alexander-93
porsche-panamera.alt: Porsche Panamera 4 (third generation, type 972) in black, front three-quarter view
porsche-panamera.note: Third-generation Panamera (972, 2024 on), the generation sold in India: new headlamps and bumper with separate side intakes. This is a Panamera 4; the Indian base Panamera has the same body.

porsche-panamera.author: Alexander-93
porsche-panamera.alt: Porsche Panamera 4 (type 972) in black, rear three-quarter view
porsche-panamera.note: Same 972 Panamera from the rear: slim full-width light bar.

porsche-macan-electric.author: M 93
porsche-macan-electric.alt: Porsche Macan Electric in dark grey, front three-quarter view
porsche-macan-electric.note: All-electric Macan (XAB platform, 2024 on): split headlamps with the main lights in the bumper, closed front. Not the petrol Macan. German car; same as the Indian Macan Electric.

porsche-macan-electric.author: M 93
porsche-macan-electric.alt: Porsche Macan Electric in dark grey, rear three-quarter view
porsche-macan-electric.note: Same Macan Electric from the rear: full-width light bar with PORSCHE lettering.

porsche-cayenne.author: M 93
porsche-cayenne.alt: Porsche Cayenne (third generation facelift) in white, front three-quarter view
porsche-cayenne.note: E3 facelift Cayenne (2023 on): new headlamps, flatter bonnet and intakes with horizontal blades. Base Cayenne, as sold in India.

porsche-cayenne.author: M 93
porsche-cayenne.alt: Porsche Cayenne (third generation facelift) in white, rear three-quarter view
porsche-cayenne.note: Same facelifted Cayenne from the rear: three-dimensional tail lamps joined by the light bar, number plate in the bumper.

porsche-cayenne-coupe.file: File:Porsche Cayenne E-Hybrid Coupé (III, Facelift) – f 01012025.jpg
porsche-cayenne-coupe.author: M 93
porsche-cayenne-coupe.alt: Porsche Cayenne Coupé (facelift) in white, front three-quarter view
porsche-cayenne-coupe.note: E3 facelift Cayenne Coupé (2023 on): coupé roofline with the facelift front end. E-Hybrid version; the Indian petrol Cayenne Coupé has the same body.

porsche-cayenne-coupe.author: Alexander-93
porsche-cayenne-coupe.alt: Porsche Cayenne Coupé S (facelift) in black, rear three-quarter view
porsche-cayenne-coupe.note: Facelifted Cayenne Coupé S showing the sloping roofline, fixed roof spoiler and facelift light bar.

porsche-cayenne-electric.author: Alexander Migl
porsche-cayenne-electric.alt: Porsche Cayenne Electric in blue, front three-quarter view
porsche-cayenne-electric.note: All-electric Cayenne (2026 on), not the petrol E3: slim headlamps, closed front and low air intakes. Production car on German plates.

porsche-cayenne-electric.author: Alexander Migl
porsche-cayenne-electric.alt: Porsche Cayenne Electric in blue, rear three-quarter view
porsche-cayenne-electric.note: Same Cayenne Electric from the rear: light bar with PORSCHE lettering and the new rear bumper.
